# vaulted-null_encrypt (Ephemeral Resource)

Ephemeral resource to encrypt plaintext content. The encrypted result is available during the Terraform run but is not stored in state for security.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plaintext` (String, Sensitive) The plaintext content to encrypt

### Read-Only

- `encrypted` (String) The encrypted content (vaulted format)
- `id` (String) Resource identifier
